rivals.name: Serik Voss
rivals.title: The Ashen Challenger
rivals.description: A hard-eyed mercenary who treats every route like a test of discipline and every other champion like a benchmark to erase.
rivals.portrait_hint: scarred mercenary in ash-gray leathers, disciplined duelist posture, iron sigil worked into the collar, cold watchful eyes

appearances.hook: Serik has been taking measure of every new champion who survives the yard.
appearances.taunt: Keep your pace clean. I only bother remembering the ones who do.
appearances.stakes: He wants the yard talking about him, not you.

appearances.hook: Serik arrived ahead of the dead and decided the village would be his proof of superiority.
appearances.taunt: If you want this village to remember your name, beat me to the kill.
appearances.stakes: Every win here shifts the survivors' faith toward whoever looks inevitable.

appearances.hook: Serik has followed the trail beneath the well and means to take the final credit for ending the curse.
appearances.taunt: You survived the village. Now prove you deserve to be the one it remembers.
appearances.stakes: If Serik takes the source below the well, the whole route will call him the region's true conqueror.
